note: What people are actually searching for and buying this season, refreshed every morning.

groups.title: Gifts for the whole friend group
groups.why: Etsy says gifting friends and pets is a big theme this year, and sales of 'Friendsmas' party supplies have climbed.

items.n: Best friend book to fill in
Pet Christmas bauble with their name

groups.title: Craftmas: make it together
groups.why: Crafting together is this season's best-backed trend, with a big craft retailer reporting a sharp jump in guided kit sales.

groups.title: Toys with a throwback twist
groups.why: Big UK toy lists are full of retro favourites given a modern upgrade, so parents can share what they loved as kids.

groups.title: Squishy, hatching and collectible
groups.why: Toy shops and US top-toy roundups keep pointing to slow-rise squishies, interactive pets, hatching eggs and mystery collectibles.

groups.title: Icy blue, silver and celestial
groups.why: Etsy trend watchers say pale frosty blues, mirrored finishes and moon-and-star motifs are the fresh alternative to classic red and gold.

groups.title: Maximalist, sparkly and a bit extra
groups.why: Etsy's 'Merrymaxxing' look of whimsical, bedazzled decorations is showing up in big-store Christmas ranges too.

groups.title: Viral cosy and self-care
groups.why: These home comforts and beauty buys spread on TikTok months before Christmas and are now selling well.
